name: Backgammon Table: Tavla 3D
subtitle: 3D backgammon with a coach
shortDescription: Real 3D backgammon: strong opponent, coach, lessons and Greek variants.
longDescription:
Backgammon Deluxe is a polished 3D backgammon table for your phone and tablet. Roll real dice in a felt tray, click your checkers home over a walnut, leather or stone board, and play against an opponent that thinks.

### Five Games On One Board
Backgammon with the doubling cube, the Crawford rule and matches to 1, 3, 5, 7 or 9 points, or unlimited money play with the Jacoby rule. Tavla, the Turkish coffeehouse game. Portes, the classic Greek game. Plakoto, where a lone checker is pinned under yours. Fevga, the Greek running game of blocks and walls. Every rule set is explained in full in the Rules pages.

### A Strong Opponent
Six levels from Apprentice to Grandmaster, plus Adaptive, which follows your results. The computer evaluates positions with a trained neural network and looks one roll ahead at every reply. It also plays the cube: it doubles, takes and drops with the match score in mind. Prefer a friend? Play two players on one device.

### A Coach That Explains
A win-chance bar shows how the position looks. Tap Hint for the engine's choice with arrows on the board. After each turn the coach tells you if a clearly better play existed and how much it cost. Statistics track your best-play rate and your average loss per turn.

### Learn At Your Own Pace
Twelve hands-on lessons cover moving, hitting, entering from the bar, making points, doubles, bearing off, the cube, pins in Plakoto, running in Fevga and the best opening plays. Puzzles give you a real position and a roll and grade your move. A new Position of the Day arrives for everyone every day. Watch and Learn plays a whole game for you with a line of commentary for every turn, with a real Pause. After any game you can review it turn by turn.

### World Tour
Travel to eight tables: an Istanbul coffeehouse, a kafeneio in Thessaloniki, a harbour cafe in Chania, Plaka in Athens, a cafe in Beirut, a London club, a Geneva salon and the Grand Match. Win matches to earn stars and unlock new boards, checker sets and dice.

### Built For Your Hands
Portrait or landscape, phone or tablet. In portrait the board turns so it fills the screen with your home board under your thumb. Tap a checker and a gold ring, or drag it. Undo until you finish your turn. Point numbers, text size up to 300 percent, automatic rolling and forced-move play are in Settings.

### Details That Matter
Lathe-turned checkers, ivory dice with painted pips, a gold doubling cube, brass hinges, soft shadows, wooden clacks, a dice rattle and optional vibration on every move. Six boards, four checker sets and three dice sets. Twenty-two trophies.

Free to play with ads. An optional monthly subscription removes ads, or you can watch a short video to play ad-free for a while.
